tickets.title: Fix missing async init guards causing double-init races in 3 services
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. UnifiedRecipeService.initialize() — no _isInitializing guard
`lib/services/unified/unified_recipe_service.dart:442–530`

Only checks `_isInitialized` (completed state), not in-progress. Two callers (bootstrap + auth-state-change) can both enter the body simultaneously. Both call `_recipes.clear()`, both set up `_authSubscription` (first leaks), both start `_cacheModule.startFirebaseSync()`. Result: duplicate stream subscriptions, transient blank recipe lists, notifyListeners storm.

Correct pattern exists at `SharedContentCoordinatorViewModel:209`: `if (_isInitialized || _isInitializing) return;`

### 2. FriendsStateManager.initialize() — same missing guard
`lib/services/unified/friends/friends_state_manager.dart:63–97`

Both FriendsViewModel constructor and re-auth events can call initialize() simultaneously. Both pass `_isInitialized == false`, both call `Future.wait([_loadFriends...])`, both call `_setupRealtimeListeners()` which cancels and re-creates subscriptions — but the first call's subscriptions get cancelled before delivering data.

### 3. FriendsProfileCacheManager.loadUserProfilesForRequests() — duplicate requests
`lib/viewmodels/friends/friends_profile_cache_manager.dart:27–82`

`_isLoadingUserProfiles` is a UI flag, not a re-entrancy guard. Two concurrent calls both compute the same uncached user IDs, make duplicate Firestore reads.

## Why It Matters
Double-init causes leaked stream subscriptions, duplicate Firestore listeners, transient blank states on app start.

## Suggested Fix
1-2. Add `bool _isInitializing = false` guard matching SharedContentCoordinatorViewModel pattern
3. Add `if (_isLoadingUserProfiles) return` re-entrancy guard

tickets.title: Fix stale closures and uncancellable retries causing silent data loss (5 locations)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. PersonalRecipeModule sync retry captures stale recipe — DATA LOSS
`lib/services/unified/modules/personal_recipe_module.dart:724–807`

Retry closure captures the `recipe` object from the original failed call, not the current version in `_recipes`. If the user edits between failed sync and retry (at 5s, 10s, 20s intervals), retry overwrites the newer version in Firestore.

### 2. SocialOperationsInitializer.scheduleRetry() — unbounded recursive retry
`lib/services/unified/helpers/social_operations_initializer.dart:98–113`

No max retry count, no cancellation token. `delay.inSeconds * 2` with sub-1s initial delay produces tight loop.

### 3. RetaggingScheduler — _isRetagging is not an async lock
`lib/services/tagging/retagging_scheduler.dart:57–95`

Periodic timer + scheduled call both enter `_performRetagging()`, causing duplicate `_saveRecipe()`. Also `Future.delayed(5s)` survives dispose().

### 4. FriendsViewModel stale closure in Future.delayed
`lib/viewmodels/friends_viewmodel.dart:399–408`

Callback fires between `_isDisposed = true` and `super.dispose()` — assertion errors during logout.

## Why It Matters
Finding 1 causes silent data loss. Findings 2-3 cause unbounded retries or duplicate writes.

## Suggested Fix
1. Re-read recipe from `_recipes[recipe.id]` at retry time
2. Add max retry count, store Timer reference for cancellation
3. Use Completer-based lock; cancel Future.delayed in dispose
4. Check _isDisposed after super.dispose()

tickets.title: Fix cache counter drift, presence stream deadlock, and search term mixing (3 concurrency bugs)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. IntelligentCacheManager — memory counter drift → unbounded growth
`lib/services/performance/intelligent_cache_manager.dart:257–294, 460–471`

Two Timer.periodic callbacks and clearCache() concurrently mutate `_currentMemoryUsage`. clearCache() sets counter to 0 while prefetch is mid-await. After await resumes, `_cacheRecipe` adds `+= size` on zeroed counter. Counter drifts, `_ensureMemoryAvailable()` never evicts → OOM.

### 2. PresenceService — asyncMap + inner await for deadlocks
`lib/services/presence_service.dart:391–409`

`asyncMap` on broadcast stream with inner `await for (... in streams[i].take(1))`. If streams[i] doesn't emit, await for hangs indefinitely, stalling all presence updates. 3+ participant scenario triggers it.

### 3. SharedContentSearchViewModel — stale _searchQuery across sequential awaits
`lib/viewmodels/shared_content/shared_content_search_viewmodel.dart:295–370`

`_searchQuery` is a field, not local copy. Between three sequential `await _searchContent(...)` calls, a keystroke changes it. Recipe results from "piz" mixed with menu results from "pizza".

## Why It Matters
Finding 1 causes OOM. Finding 2 causes stale presence. Finding 3 causes incorrect search results.

## Suggested Fix
1. Snapshot `_currentMemoryUsage` or use Completer-based lock
2. Replace `asyncMap` + `await for` with `Rx.combineLatest`
3. Snapshot `final query = _searchQuery` at method start; cancel in-flight search on new query

tickets.title: Fix 55+ trivial test assertions giving false coverage confidence across 15 test files
tickets.description:
## Finding

### expect(true, isTrue) placeholder assertions (30+ tests)
Tests that always pass regardless of implementation:
- `notification_service_test.dart:148,198,220,245,267,309` — 6 tests
- `messaging_service_test.dart:816,1330,1340,1411,1464` — 5 tests (3 for unimplemented methods)
- `recipe_social_stats_test.dart:746,801` — rating aggregates
- `realtime_event_handler_test.dart:301,317` — notifications
- `startup_optimization_manager_test.dart:116,125` — service registration
- `performance_monitoring_service_test.dart:129,138` — initialize
- `intelligent_cache_manager_test.dart:249,322` — initialize + preload
- Plus 7 more files with 1 placeholder each

### url_import_strategy_test.dart — 29 tests with only expect(strategy, isNotNull)
Lines 207–458: Tests named for specific behaviors but only assert non-null. Entire extraction pipeline has zero real assertions.

### Tests for unimplemented methods
`messaging_service_test.dart:1334,1404,1457` — tests for addReaction/removeReaction/updatePresence that don't exist.

## Why It Matters
These create phantom coverage. url_import_strategy_test alone has 29 tests that pass even if the entire implementation were deleted.

## Suggested Fix
1. Replace `expect(true, isTrue)` with actual state/interaction assertions
2. url_import_strategy_test: assert extracted title, ingredients, instructions
3. Delete tests for unimplemented methods
4. Replace `isA<String?>()` with content verification

tickets.title: Fix 13+ flaky timing tests and 20+ improperly skipped tests
tickets.description:
## Finding

### Flaky: Future.delayed without fakeAsync in unit tests
- `collaborative_status_viewmodel_test.dart` — 13× `Future.delayed(100-200ms)` for async state propagation
- `rate_limiter_test.dart:71,84,432` — 3× `Future.delayed(1100ms)` for token bucket refill

### Improperly skipped with no resolution plan
- `firebase_connectivity_repository_test.dart` — 7 tests skip: 'Requires Flutter bindings'
- `friend_relationship_repository_test.dart` — 3 tests skip: 'FieldValue.increment'
- `friend_category_repository_test.dart` — 3 tests skip: 'FieldValue.arrayUnion/Remove'
- `group_invitation_repository_test.dart` — 4 tests skip: 'FieldValue.serverTimestamp'
- `startup_optimization_manager_test.dart` — 3 tests skip: 'singleton state persistence'

### Singleton state leaking between tests
- `startup_optimization_manager_test.dart` — singleton retains initialized state

## Why It Matters
Flaky tests erode CI trust. Skipped tests create false coverage confidence.

## Suggested Fix
1. Replace Future.delayed with fakeAsync + async.elapse()
2. Add TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized() for connectivity tests
3. Use fake_cloud_firestore FieldValue support or mock at service layer
4. Add singleton reset capability

tickets.title: Fix widget architecture: duplicated card subtrees, deep nesting, context threading, setState anti-patterns (10+ views)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### Duplicated widget subtrees
1. `shared_recipe_card.dart`, `shared_menu_card.dart`, `shared_shopping_list_card.dart` — identical outer skeleton and _buildHeader across all three
2. `privacy_policy_view.dart`, `terms_of_service_view.dart`, `community_guidelines_view.dart` — identical _buildContactButton footer
3. `notification_preferences_view.dart:118,165,220,333,358` — SwitchListTile thumbColor block duplicated 5×

### Deep nesting (10+ levels)
4. `recipe_detail_content.dart:183–279` — ingredient row 11 levels deep
5. `recipe_detail_view.dart:94–563` — main build 12+ levels

### Context threading through static methods
6. shared_*_card.dart — context passed through 4 levels of static method calls

### setState anti-patterns
7. `recipe_detail_view.dart:539,548` — empty setState(() {}) forces full view rebuild
8. `mfa_settings_view.dart:70,121–130,134` — 3× setState in single async method

### Unnecessary StatefulWidgets
9. `emoji_reaction_picker.dart:68–111` — StatefulWidget for single bool hover
10. `search_input_widget.dart:17–75` — StatefulWidget solely for empty setState on text change

## Why It Matters
Duplicated subtrees mean bugs fixed in one card aren't fixed in others. Deep nesting defeats rebuild optimization. Empty setState causes full-subtree rebuilds.

## Suggested Fix
1. Extract SharedContentCardShell + SharedContentCardHeader
2. Extract LegalContactFooter widget
3. Extract _butlerySwitchTheme() helper
4-5. Extract _IngredientRow and _RecipeTitleSection
6. Convert static classes to proper StatelessWidget subclasses
7-8. Use ViewModel notifyListeners instead of parent setState
9-10. Convert to StatelessWidget with AnimatedBuilder

tickets.title: Fix service contract bugs: findByTitle never matches, notification prefs dual collection, FCM token deletion (6 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. findByTitle() never matches — duplicate detection broken
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_recipe_repository.dart:567–577`

Query uses lowercase but toFirestore() stores original case. Firestore exact comparison → never matches.

### 2. Notification preferences in two different Firestore collections
Legacy: `notification_preferences` vs New: `user_notification_preferences`. UI writes to legacy, interface reads from new → always defaults.

### 3. removeFCMToken ignores token parameter, deletes ALL tokens
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_notifications_repository.dart:374–378`

Multi-device users lose push for all devices when one signs out.

### 4. setActiveList is in-memory only
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_shopping_repository.dart:292–294`

Lost on cold start. getActiveList() returns null.

### 5. toFirestore() writes DateTime, fromFirestore() reads Timestamp
`notifications_repository.dart:143` and `ratings_repository.dart:78`. Latent crash on base class create() path.

### 6. Two parallel NotificationRepository classes
Legacy (not DI-registered) vs new (DI-registered). NotificationService bypasses DI.

## Why It Matters
Finding 1: All import duplicate detection broken. Finding 2: Notification prefs never persist. Finding 3: Multi-device push broken on logout.

## Suggested Fix
1. Store normalizedTitle in toFirestore(), query against that
2. Consolidate to one collection; delete legacy repository
3. Use FieldValue.arrayRemove([token]) for specific token
4. Persist _activeListId via SharedPreferences
5. Use Timestamp.fromDate() in toFirestore
6. Merge into single DI-registered repository

tickets.title: Fix accessibility gaps: auth contrast fail, missing autofocus, responsive wrappers, focus management (14 locations)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### WCAG contrast failure
1. `auth_view.dart:128–131` — Tagline ~1.9:1 contrast, needs 4.5:1

### Missing autofocus
2. `auth_view.dart:543–553` — Password reset dialog no autofocus

### Link semantics
3. `auth_view.dart:439–472` — GestureDetector on bare Text, no tap target, no Semantics(link: true)

### Missing responsive wrappers
4. `faq_view.dart:28–30` — No Center + ConstrainedBox
5. `onboarding_view.dart:61` + `onboarding_allergen_page.dart:65` — No max-width, fixed crossAxisCount: 2

### Keyboard/focus
6. `account_security_view.dart:148–215` — 5 TextFields no Tab progression
7. `tag_detail_view.dart:75–79` — Edit mode no requestFocus()

### Tap targets (new locations)
8-10. cooking_mode close (40px), stepper (36px), Lagat idag shrinkWrap

### Cooking mode
11. Non-Expanded Row overflows at 1.3x text scale
12. Forces landscape with no portrait fallback

### Screen reader
13. `mina_recept_view.dart:520–539` — Selection state not in Semantics

Contrast failure affects all users. Missing keyboard nav breaks web. 36px tap targets fail mobile accessibility.

tickets.title: Fix Cloud Functions auth gaps: 4 missing admin checks, rate limit key mismatch, imageUrl SSRF, LLM cost abuse (9 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Missing admin authorization (4 functions)
`functions/src/admin/` — `cleanupOrphanedData`, `migrateUserData`, `forceReindex`, `bulkDeleteUsers` check `auth.uid` exists but never verify admin role/claim. Any authenticated user can call them.

### 2. Rate limiter key mismatch
`functions/src/middleware/rateLimiter.ts` — key uses `req.ip` but behind Cloud Run proxy, `req.ip` is always the proxy IP. All users share one rate limit bucket.

### 3. imageUrl SSRF in recipe import
`functions/src/import/processRecipeImport.ts` — accepts user-supplied `imageUrl`, fetches it server-side with no URL validation. Can probe internal GCP metadata endpoint (`169.254.169.254`).

### 4. LLM API cost abuse
`functions/src/ai/generateTags.ts` — no per-user daily quota. Single user can trigger unlimited OpenAI API calls.

### 5-9. Input validation gaps
Missing field length limits on recipe title (can store 1MB string), missing Content-Type validation, no request body size limit on 3 endpoints.

## Why It Matters
Admin functions callable by any user = full data wipe possible. SSRF = GCP credential theft. No LLM quota = unbounded cost.

## Suggested Fix
1. Add `verifyAdminClaim(context)` helper checking custom claims
2. Use `req.headers['x-forwarded-for']` or Cloud Run `X-Cloud-Trace-Context`
3. Validate URL scheme (https only) + block private IP ranges
4. Add per-user daily call counter in Firestore
5-9. Add express-validator middleware with field length limits

tickets.title: Fix Cloud Functions: idempotency failures, OOM cleanup, N+1 queries, wrong timeout config (9 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Non-idempotent onCreate triggers
`functions/src/triggers/onRecipeCreate.ts`, `onUserCreate.ts` — Cloud Functions can retry on timeout. These create denormalized docs without checking if they already exist → duplicate data on retry.

### 2. cleanupOrphanedData fetches all docs into memory
`functions/src/admin/cleanupOrphanedData.ts` — `const allRecipes = await db.collection('recipes').get()` loads entire collection. Will OOM at ~10k recipes.

### 3. N+1 query in generateWeeklyDigest
`functions/src/scheduled/weeklyDigest.ts` — loops users, fetches recipes one-by-one inside loop instead of batch query.

### 4. Wrong timeout/memory on v2 functions
3 functions set `timeoutSeconds: 60` (v1 syntax) in v2 `onCall` options — silently ignored, gets default 60s which may be too short for batch operations.

### 5-9. Error handling gaps
5 functions catch errors but return `{success: true}` anyway, 2 functions don't catch at all (unhandled rejection → cold start on next call).

## Why It Matters
Non-idempotent triggers cause duplicate data. OOM crashes cleanup function. N+1 causes weekly digest timeout.

## Suggested Fix
1. Check document existence before create in triggers
2. Use paginated query with `startAfter` cursor
3. Batch user recipe queries with `where('userId', 'in', chunk)`
4. Use `timeoutSeconds` in `GlobalOptions` or per-function `HttpsOptions`
5-9. Return error status on catch, add try-catch to unguarded functions

tickets.title: Fix CRITICAL: Firestore rules missing for camelCase denorm collections + 8 more collections (menu/shopping sharing broken)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Denormalized collections use camelCase, rules use snake_case
`firestore.rules` has rules for `shared_recipes`, `shared_menus`, `shared_shopping_lists` but app code writes to `sharedRecipes`, `sharedMenus`, `sharedShoppingLists`. Rules never match → default deny → all sharing silently fails.

### 2. 8 collections with no rules at all
- `userPresence` — presence writes blocked
- `recipeEngagements` — likes/comments blocked
- `menuTemplates` — menu template CRUD blocked
- `shoppingListItems` (subcollection) — item add/remove blocked
- `friendCategories` — category management blocked
- `groupInvitations` — group invite flow blocked
- `userNotificationPreferences` — notification prefs blocked
- `recipeImportQueue` — import queue blocked

### 3. Collection naming inconsistency
Mix of camelCase (`userPresence`) and snake_case (`user_profiles`) across codebase. No naming convention enforced.

## Why It Matters
CRITICAL: All social sharing features (recipes, menus, shopping lists) are silently broken in production. Firestore default-deny means writes succeed client-side (optimistic) but fail server-side.

## Suggested Fix
1. Add rules for camelCase collection names matching app code
2. Add rules for all 8 missing collections with proper auth checks
3. Document naming convention, migrate to consistent style in next major version

tickets.title: Fix Firestore rule logic bugs: menu reads permanently denied, reactions blocked, ownership hijack (7 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Menu read rule permanently denies after unshare
`firestore.rules:847` — `resource.data.sharedWith` checked but field removed on unshare instead of set to empty array. `resource.data.sharedWith` → field doesn't exist → rule throws → deny. Owner also locked out.

### 2. Reactions subcollection create blocked
`firestore.rules:923` — requires `request.resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid` but client sends `authorId` field instead.

### 3. Recipe ownership hijack via update
`firestore.rules:312` — update rule checks `request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId` but doesn't prevent changing `userId` field. User can transfer ownership to themselves for any recipe they can update.

### 4. Comment delete allows any participant
`firestore.rules:945` — delete rule checks group membership but not comment authorship. Any group member can delete anyone's comments.

### 5-7. Minor logic issues
5. `get()` in rules counts toward quota but result uncached across rule evaluations
6. `hasAll` used where `hasAny` intended for permission check
7. Timestamp validation allows future dates (no `<= request.time` check)

## Why It Matters
Finding 1: Menus permanently inaccessible after unshare. Finding 3: Any collaborator can steal recipe ownership.

## Suggested Fix
1. Check `'sharedWith' in resource.data && request.auth.uid in resource.data.sharedWith` with existence guard
2. Change field name to `authorId` in rule or `userId` in client
3. Add `!('userId' in request.resource.data) || request.resource.data.userId == resource.data.userId` to prevent ownership change
4. Add `resource.data.authorId == request.auth.uid || isOwner()` to comment delete
5-7. Cache get() results, fix hasAll→hasAny, add timestamp bounds

tickets.title: Fix app lifecycle: deep link dropped on cold start, FCM navigation unwired, auth token expiry swallowed (3 critical bugs)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Deep link dropped on cold start
`lib/services/deep_link_service.dart:45–67` — `getInitialLink()` called in `initialize()` but result stored before `NavigatorState` is available. Link processed, `_pendingDeepLink` set, but no widget is listening yet. After widget tree builds and subscribes, pending link already consumed.

### 2. FCM notification tap navigation unwired
`lib/services/notification/fcm_service.dart:89–112` — `onMessageOpenedApp` handler parses payload and calls `_handleNotificationTap()` which is a stub that only logs. User taps notification → app opens to home screen, not the relevant content.

### 3. Auth token expiry swallowed
`lib/services/auth/auth_service.dart:234–241` — `onIdTokenChanged` catches `FirebaseAuthException` for expired token but only logs warning. No force-refresh attempted, no user redirect to login. User sees stale data until app restart.

## Why It Matters
Deep links from shared recipes/menus don't work on cold start (most common case). Notification taps don't navigate. Expired auth tokens cause silent data staleness.

## Suggested Fix
1. Queue pending deep link, process after first frame via `WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback`
2. Implement `_handleNotificationTap()` with route resolution from payload type
3. Call `user.getIdToken(true)` on expiry, redirect to login on failure

tickets.title: Fix app lifecycle: auto-save lost on background kill, presence ghost, offline sync race, FCM stub (4 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Auto-save lost on background kill
`lib/viewmodels/recipe_form_viewmodel.dart:89–95` — dirty form state only saved on explicit save button. `AppLifecycleState.paused` handler missing. OS kills backgrounded app → unsaved edits lost.

### 2. Presence ghost after app kill
`lib/services/presence_service.dart:156–170` — `onDisconnect()` handler set on Firebase RTDB but only for graceful disconnect. Force-kill leaves presence as 'online' indefinitely. No server-side TTL.

### 3. Offline sync race on reconnect
`lib/services/unified/modules/personal_recipe_module.dart:612–640` — `_pendingWrites` queue replayed on connectivity change, but no ordering guarantee. If user edited recipe A then B offline, B might sync before A, and A's sync overwrites B's `lastModified`.

### 4. FCM token refresh stub
`lib/services/notification/fcm_service.dart:134–138` — `onTokenRefresh` stream listened but handler is `TODO: implement`. Old token becomes invalid, push notifications stop until app reinstall.

## Why It Matters
Auto-save loss frustrates users. Ghost presence misleads collaborators. Token refresh stub breaks push after token rotation.

## Suggested Fix
1. Add `WidgetsBindingObserver` + save dirty state on `paused`/`detached`
2. Add server-side presence TTL (Cloud Function cron: mark offline if no heartbeat in 5min)
3. Add sequence number to pending writes, replay in order
4. Implement token refresh: call `updateFCMToken(newToken)` on repository

tickets.title: Fix iOS critical misconfigs: wrong bundle ID in Firebase config, deployment target 13.0, https URL scheme, missing entitlements (5 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. GoogleService-Info.plist bundle ID mismatch
`ios/Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist:BUNDLE_ID` = `com.example.butlery` but `ios/Runner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj:PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER` = `com.butlery.app`. Firebase SDK will fail to initialize on real iOS device.

### 2. iOS deployment target 13.0
`ios/Podfile:platform :ios, '13.0'` — Firebase iOS SDK 11.x requires iOS 15.0+. Pod install will fail or produce runtime crashes.

### 3. URL scheme uses https
`ios/Runner/Info.plist:CFBundleURLSchemes` includes `https` — this is reserved by the system. Should use custom scheme like `butlery://`.

### 4. Missing Associated Domains entitlement
No `Runner.entitlements` file with `applinks:` domain. Universal links (deep links) won't work on iOS.

### 5. Missing push notification entitlement
No `aps-environment` in entitlements. FCM push notifications will silently fail on iOS.

## Why It Matters
Bundle ID mismatch = Firebase crash on launch = app unusable on iOS. Deployment target too low = pod install failure.

## Suggested Fix
1. Update GoogleService-Info.plist BUNDLE_ID to `com.butlery.app`
2. Update Podfile to `platform :ios, '15.0'`
3. Replace `https` URL scheme with `butlery`
4. Add `Runner.entitlements` with `applinks:butlery.app`
5. Add `aps-environment` = `production` to entitlements

tickets.title: Fix platform config: Cloud Functions region mismatch (NOT_FOUND), missing security headers, storage permission (4 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Cloud Functions region mismatch
`lib/services/cloud_functions_service.dart:15` — `FirebaseFunctions.instanceFor(region: 'us-central1')` but `functions/src/index.ts` deploys to `europe-west1`. All callable function invocations return NOT_FOUND.

### 2. Missing web security headers
`web/index.html` — no Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, or X-Content-Type-Options headers. App embeddable in iframe (clickjacking).

### 3. Android storage permission for image upload
`android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` — missing `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES` permission (Android 13+). Image picker will fail silently on newer devices.

### 4. Firebase Storage CORS not configured
No `cors.json` deployed to Firebase Storage bucket. Web uploads may fail with CORS errors.

## Why It Matters
Region mismatch means ALL Cloud Function calls fail in production (NOT_FOUND). Missing storage permission breaks image upload on Android 13+.

## Suggested Fix
1. Change region to `europe-west1` in `cloud_functions_service.dart`
2. Add security headers via Firebase Hosting `firebase.json` headers config
3. Add `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES` + `READ_MEDIA_VIDEO` permissions
4. Deploy `cors.json` with allowed origins to Firebase Storage

tickets.title: Fix recipe parsing: no HTTP response size limit (OOM), no charset detection, JSON-LD @type array missed, instructions discarded (6 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. No HTTP response size limit
`lib/services/import/url_import_strategy.dart:78–92` — `http.get(url)` reads entire response into memory. Malicious or misconfigured URL serving 500MB file → OOM crash.

### 2. No charset detection
`lib/services/import/url_import_strategy.dart:95` — `response.body` assumes UTF-8 but many recipe sites use ISO-8859-1 or Windows-1252. Swedish characters (å, ä, ö) corrupted on import from older sites.

### 3. JSON-LD @type as array missed
`lib/services/parsing/recipe_parser_service.dart:234–240` — checks `jsonLd['@type'] == 'Recipe'` but Schema.org allows `@type: ['Recipe', 'HowTo']`. Array form silently skipped → falls back to less accurate HTML scraping.

### 4. HowToSection instructions discarded
`lib/services/parsing/recipe_parser_service.dart:312–330` — `recipeInstructions` handler processes `HowToStep` but ignores `HowToSection` wrapper. Grouped instructions (e.g., 'For the dough:', 'For the filling:') lose all steps inside sections.

### 5. Yield field parsing ignores servings format
`lib/services/parsing/recipe_parser_service.dart:198` — `recipeYield: '4-6 servings'` parsed as string, not extracted to numeric range.

### 6. Duration parsing breaks on non-ISO format
`lib/services/parsing/recipe_parser_service.dart:205` — expects ISO 8601 (`PT30M`) but some sites use `30 min` or `30 minutes`. Parse fails silently → null cook time.

## Why It Matters
OOM from unbounded response is a DoS vector. Charset corruption affects all Swedish recipe sites using legacy encoding.

## Suggested Fix
1. Use `http.Client` with `StreamedResponse` + max bytes check (10MB limit)
2. Read `Content-Type` charset header, use `dart:convert` Encoding.getByName
3. Check `jsonLd['@type'] is List ? jsonLd['@type'].contains('Recipe') : jsonLd['@type'] == 'Recipe'`
4. Recursively unwrap HowToSection → extract HowToStep children
5. Regex extract numeric portion from yield string
6. Add fallback duration parser for common non-ISO formats

tickets.title: Fix DI lifecycle: cross-module dependency order bugs (StateError at bootstrap) + singleton streams not reset on logout (8 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Cross-module dependency order not enforced
`lib/di/` modules declare `priority` but 3 modules have equal priority with cross-dependencies. `SocialModule` (priority 30) depends on `UnifiedRecipeService` from `RecipeModule` (priority 30). Registration order within same priority is insertion order → works by accident. Adding a new module at priority 30 can break bootstrap.

### 2. Circular dependency: NotificationService ↔ FriendsService
`NotificationService` constructor takes `FriendsService` for friend-request notifications. `FriendsService` constructor takes `NotificationService` for sending notifications. Both registered in `SocialModule` → one must be registered first → the other's dependency is null at construction.

### 3. Singleton streams not reset on logout
`UnifiedRecipeService`, `PresenceService`, `IntelligentCacheManager` — registered as singletons in DI. On logout, `_recipes` map and stream subscriptions retained. On re-login as different user, previous user's data visible briefly.

### 4. dispose() never called on DI singletons
`lib/di/di_container.dart:reset()` calls `GetIt.instance.reset()` but doesn't call `dispose()` on ChangeNotifier singletons first. StreamControllers and listeners leak.

### 5-8. Registration gaps
5. `AnalyticsService` registered but depends on unregistered `ConsentManager`
6. `ImageUploadService` registered in `MediaModule` but `StorageRepository` in `FirebaseModule` — no declared dependency
7. Two `RecipeRepository` registrations (one in `FirebaseModule`, one in `RecipeModule`) — last wins silently
8. `TaggingService` registered as factory but used as singleton by callers caching the instance

## Why It Matters
Finding 1: Bootstrap crash on innocent module addition. Finding 3: Cross-user data leakage on logout/re-login. Finding 4: Resource leaks accumulate across auth cycles.

## Suggested Fix
1. Enforce dependency ordering: modules declare `dependsOn: [ModuleName]`, DI container topologically sorts
2. Break circular dep with lazy initialization or event bus
3. Add `resetUserState()` method to stateful singletons, call on logout
4. Call `dispose()` on all ChangeNotifier singletons before `reset()`
5-8. Audit and fix registration: remove duplicate, declare dependencies, convert TaggingService to singleton

tickets.title: Fix search infrastructure: debounce Completer leak, static mixin state, watchRecipes 50-doc cap (4 critical bugs)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. executeDebounced leaks Completer futures on rapid keypresses
`lib/core/mixins/async_operation_mixin.dart:133–159`

Each call creates a new `Completer<T?>`, then cancels the previous timer. Cancelled Completers are never completed — they leak, awaiting forever. `RecipeQueryViewModel.updateSearchQuery` (line 104) `await`s this. 10 rapid keypresses = 9 permanently abandoned Completers holding references.

### 2. watchRecipes stream silently truncates to 50 recipes
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_recipe_repository.dart:352–360`

The live stream feeding `UnifiedRecipeService.recipes` has `.limit(50)` ordered by `updatedAt desc`. Users with 51+ recipes never see older ones in any filter/search/sort. UI pagination operates on the already-truncated list.

### 3. Static _executionTimes is process-global — leaks across instances and auth sessions
`lib/core/mixins/async_operation_mixin.dart:360–368`

`static final Map<String, DateTime> _executionTimes` shared across ALL mixin instances. Never cleared on logout. Throttle timestamps from one user persist into next session, silently suppressing operations.

### 4. Debounce does not cancel in-flight async operation
`lib/core/mixins/async_operation_mixin.dart:46–60`

`executeDebounced` cancels the pending timer, but if a search is already executing inside `executeNamedOperation`, the next debounced search hits `_activeOperations.contains('recipeSearch')` and throws `StateError`. User sees no results update.

## Why It Matters
Finding 1: Memory leak and hung awaits. Finding 2: Users with 51+ recipes have silently incomplete search/filter results. Finding 3: Cross-user state leakage.

## Suggested Fix
1. Complete old Completer with `null` before replacing it
2. Remove `.limit(50)` from `watchRecipes`; use cursor-based pagination
3. Change `_executionTimes` from `static final` to instance field; clear in `dispose()`
4. Pass `allowConcurrent: true` or cancel in-flight operations properly

tickets.title: Fix search quality: Algolia empty owner, Firestore fallback unscoped, filter state leak on logout, date range off-by-one (13 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Algolia ownerDisplayName always empty
`lib/repositories/algolia/algolia_search_repository.dart:299` — hardcodes `ownerDisplayName: ''`. Author-based search never matches.

### 2. Firestore fallback search returns any public recipe, unscoped
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_search_repository.dart:35–47` — no user scope, `page` parameter ignored, client-side text filtering after limit applied.

### 3. Filter state not cleared on logout
`lib/viewmodels/recipe_list_viewmodel.dart` — allergen/dietary/tag filters survive logout. Multi-user device shows previous user's filters.

### 4. Archive search has no debounce
`lib/viewmodels/archive/archive_search_manager.dart:48–52` — `updateSearch` triggers full recompute + rebuild on every keystroke.

### 5. Archive cache uses Set.toString() comparison
`lib/viewmodels/archive/archive_search_manager.dart:84` — Set ordering not guaranteed in `toString()`, causes unnecessary cache misses.

### 6. Search history accumulates every keystroke
`lib/viewmodels/shared_content/shared_content_search_viewmodel.dart:268–273` — typing 'pasta' inserts 'p','pa','pas','past','pasta' into history.

### 7. filteredResults computed 3x per build cycle
`lib/viewmodels/shared_content/shared_content_search_viewmodel.dart:156–223` — no caching; `resultsByType` and `resultCounts` each re-call it.

### 8. DateRange.thisWeek off-by-one
`lib/viewmodels/shared_content/shared_content_search_viewmodel.dart:194–196` — `weekStart` uses time-of-day from `now`, not midnight. Items before that time on Monday excluded.

### 9. Friends search cache has no TTL
`lib/viewmodels/friends/friends_search_manager.dart:110–117` — stale results never invalidated.

### 10-13. Swedish normalization gaps
`recipe_query_viewmodel.dart:84–98` uses raw `contains()` without normalization. `search_service.dart:230–259` suggestions lack normalization. `search_repository.dart:229–259` Algolia filter strings not escaped. Firestore search pagination always returns page 0.

## Why It Matters
Algolia author search broken. Firestore fallback returns arbitrary data. Filter leak = cross-user privacy issue.

## Suggested Fix
1. Thread displayName to Algolia indexing
2. Add user scope to Firestore search; implement pagination
3. Clear filters on auth state change
4-5. Add debounce; use SetEquality
6. Move history insertion to after debounce fires
7. Cache filteredResults
8. Use midnight DateTime for week start
9. Add cache TTL
10-13. Use SwedishCharacterNormalizer everywhere; escape Algolia filters

tickets.title: Fix CRITICAL social group security: any member can hijack ownership, validateReadPermission always true, members can overwrite all fields (6 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Any group member can transfer ownership — no server-side guard
`lib/viewmodels/social_group_detail_viewmodel.dart:302–334` + `firestore.rules:205–208`

Firestore update rule allows any member listed in `friendUserIds` to update ANY field including `ownerId`. Client-side `isAdmin` check is bypassable. Any group member can transfer ownership to themselves or anyone.

### 2. validateReadPermission returns true for all group-shared content
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_social_sharing_repository.dart:107–110`

Comment says 'delegate to group-level security' but just returns `true`. Any authenticated user with a document ID can read group-shared content without being a member.

### 3. All four validate*Permission methods return true unconditionally
`lib/repositories/firebase/friends/friend_category_repository.dart:115–144`

All CRUD permissions bypass. Callers using generic `create()`/`delete()` base class methods have zero permission checks.

### 4. SharingPermissions.canEdit stored but never enforced
`lib/models/shared_content.dart:183–289` + `firestore.rules:346–351`

Firestore update rule for shared_recipes allows members to update non-ownership fields regardless of `allowCollaboration` flag.

### 5. addMember has no ownership check at Dart layer
`lib/repositories/firebase/base_shared_content_repository.dart:340–374`

Any caller can add any user as member of any content. Only Firestore rules enforce ownership.

### 6. Members can do full document set() overwriting all group fields
`lib/repositories/firebase/friends/friend_category_repository.dart:147–179`

`saveCategory` uses `.set(category.toFirestore())` — full overwrite including `ownerId`, `name`, `friendUserIds`. Any member can rename group, remove others, or set themselves as owner.

## Why It Matters
Finding 1+6: Any group member can steal ownership. Finding 2: Group content visible to non-members. Finding 4: Edit permissions meaningless.

## Suggested Fix
1. Add Firestore rule: only current owner can change `ownerId`
2. Implement actual group membership check before returning true
3. Implement real ownership checks in validate* methods
4. Add `resource.data.allowCollaboration == true` to member update rule
5. Fetch content doc and verify ownership before addMember
6. Use targeted `.update()` for non-owner members; restrict to `friendUserIds` and `updatedAt` only

tickets.title: Fix social group flow: acceptInvitation doesn't add member, cancel blocked, remove stub empty, rules mismatch (10 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. acceptInvitation only updates status — never adds user to group
`lib/repositories/firebase/friends/group_invitation_repository.dart:280–291`

Accepting changes invitation `status` to 'accepted' but never adds user to `friendUserIds` in the group document. User appears accepted but is not a member.

### 2. cancelInvitation blocked by BOTH Dart and Firestore layers
`lib/repositories/firebase/friends/group_invitation_repository.dart:306–317` + `firestore.rules:312–315`

Dart `updateInvitation()` throws if caller != `toUserId`. Firestore rules only allow `toUserId` to update. Status 'cancelled' not in allowed values. Invitation cancellation is completely dead functionality.

### 3. removeFriendFromCategoryInternal has empty body
`lib/services/unified/friends/friends_internal_operations.dart:173`

`void removeFriendFromCategoryInternal(String friendId, String categoryId) {}` — complete no-op. Remove-from-group silently fails.

### 4. syncFriendToFirebase is a documented landmine still in codebase
`lib/services/unified/friends/friends_firebase_sync.dart:62–97`

Docstring warns NOT to use it (non-atomic, wrong schema, skips friendsCount). Should be deleted.

### 5. shared_content Firestore rules use fromUserId/toUserId but model writes ownerId/sharedWithUserIds
`firestore.rules:1176–1200` + `lib/models/shared_content.dart`

Rules check fields that don't exist on real documents. All read access to shared_content is effectively denied.

### 6. No self-invite prevention in group_invitations create rule
`firestore.rules:307–310` — no `fromUserId != toUserId` check.

### 7. GroupEventBus has no group ID — fires reload for all open groups
`lib/viewmodels/social_group_detail_viewmodel.dart:140–158`

### 8. updateSharingPermissions — two non-atomic writes (TOCTOU race)
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_social_sharing_repository.dart:251–295`

### 9. Friend request expiry is client-side only
`lib/models/friend_request.dart:82` — no `expiresAt` in Firestore; expired requests can be accepted.

### 10. Shared content sort comparator always returns 0
`lib/repositories/firebase/base_shared_content_repository.dart:674`

## Why It Matters
Findings 1-3: Group invitation, acceptance, and removal flows are all broken. Finding 5: shared_content collection is inaccessible.

## Suggested Fix
1. Use transaction: update status + add to friendUserIds atomically
2. Allow sender to cancel; add 'cancelled' to rules; fix Dart check
3. Implement method body matching addFriendToCategoryInternal pattern
4. Delete syncFriendToFirebase — dead code
5. Align rules with model: use ownerId + sharedWithUserIds
6-10. Add self-check, include groupId in events, use transactions, add expiresAt, implement sort

tickets.title: Fix image pipeline: wrong Storage paths bypass security, web uploads crash on blob URL and missing compression (5 critical issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Avatar upload uses wrong Storage path — bypasses security rules
`lib/viewmodels/user_profile_viewmodel.dart:150`

Uploads to `avatars/$userId/...` but security rules only allow `users/$userId/...`. Permission validation at `firebase_storage_repository.dart:96` rejects the path. All avatar uploads fail.

### 2. Recipe images uploaded to wrong path — bypasses security
`lib/viewmodels/recipe_form/recipe_image_manager.dart:466,894,1000` + `xfile_upload_handler.dart:174`

Multiple upload calls use `recipes/$recipeId/...` instead of `users/$userId/recipes/...`. Same security rule violation.

### 3. File(blob URL) on web always crashes
`lib/viewmodels/recipe_form/recipe_image_manager.dart:888` + `xfile_upload_handler.dart:168` + `image_picker_service.dart:153`

On web, `xFile.path` is a `blob:http://...` URL. `File(xFile.path)` creates a dart:io File that doesn't exist on web. Any `.readAsBytes()` throws.

### 4. flutter_image_compress not supported on web — all file uploads fail
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_storage_repository.dart:410–474`

`compressImage()` throws `MissingPluginException` on web. Catch returns `null`. `uploadImage()` then throws 'Failed to compress image'. Recipe image uploads on web are completely broken.

### 5. uploadImageBytes has no compression — full-size bytes uploaded
`lib/services/storage_service.dart:85–118`

Passes bytes directly to repository without compression. Web avatar uploads get full-resolution images.

## Why It Matters
Findings 1-2: Avatar and recipe image uploads fail with PermissionDeniedException (or bypass security if validation is skipped). Findings 3-4: ALL image operations on web are broken.

## Suggested Fix
1-2. Fix paths to `users/$userId/avatars/...` and `users/$userId/recipes/...`
3. On web, use `xFile.readAsBytes()` directly; never construct dart:io File
4. Add `kIsWeb` check; skip compression on web or use web-compatible library
5. Call `compressImage()` on bytes before upload

tickets.title: Fix image display & cleanup: orphaned images on delete, fake CDN params, fullscreen OOM, double compression (10 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Recipe deletion never deletes Storage images — permanent orphans
`lib/services/unified/modules/service_adapters/recipe_service_adapter.dart:59–68`

`deleteRecipe()` only deletes Firestore doc. Associated Storage images at `users/$userId/recipes/` accumulate forever.

### 2. Fake transform params appended to Firebase Storage URLs
`lib/services/performance/optimized_image_loader.dart:41–68`

Appends `?w=X&h=Y&q=85&f=webp` to Firebase Storage URLs. Firebase doesn't support server-side transforms — this breaks cache keys and may break image loading.

### 3. Fullscreen viewer loads full-resolution images with no dimension limits
`lib/views/recipe_detail/fullscreen_image_viewer.dart:108–120`

No `cacheWidth`/`cacheHeight`. PageView preloads adjacent pages = 3 full-res images decoded simultaneously.

### 4. Image.network() used in 5 places without caching
fullscreen_image_viewer, profile_menu, 3 recipe selection dialogs — re-downloads on every build.

### 5. Thumbnail path derivation breaks for non-.jpg files
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_storage_repository.dart:499–501`

`.replaceAll('.jpg', '_thumb.jpg')` is no-op for `.jpeg`, `.png`, `.webp` — thumbnail overwrites original.

### 6. GDPR storage erasure failure silently swallowed
`lib/services/account/account_deletion/storage_deletion_operations.dart:59–67`

Returns `true` even when Storage deletion fails. User's files remain indefinitely.

### 7. 5MB client vs 10MB server size limit mismatch
Client rejects files the server would accept. Validation runs pre-compression.

### 8. Double compression — picker at 90% quality + flutter_image_compress
Quality loss and wasted CPU from compressing twice.

### 9. maxWidth/maxHeight defined but never passed to compressor
`firebase_storage_repository.dart:435–459` — constants exist but aren't forwarded to `FlutterImageCompress`.

### 10. Storage rules allow image/gif and any image/* via client-set contentType
`storage.rules:8–10` — SVG with embedded JS could be uploaded.

## Why It Matters
Finding 1: Unbounded Storage cost growth. Finding 2: Image loading may break. Finding 3: OOM on image carousel.

## Suggested Fix
1. Delete Storage images before Firestore doc
2. Remove Firebase from `_supportsTransformation()`
3. Add `memCacheWidth` based on screen size
4. Replace with CachedNetworkImage
5. Use path package for extension handling
6. Return false on failure; implement retry queue
7-9. Align limits; compress once; pass dimensions
10. Restrict to jpeg|png|webp

tickets.title: Fix auth security: registration without email verification, rate limiter bypassable, user enumeration via error messages (5 critical issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. Registration allows full app access without email verification
`lib/services/auth_service.dart:51–96`

`registerWithEmail()` creates Firebase account and returns `true` immediately. No `sendEmailVerification()`, no `emailVerified` check, no gate screen. Users can register with any email (including others') and gain full access.

### 2. Rate limiter bypassable via app restart — unlimited login retries
`lib/services/auth_service.dart:87–95`

Client-side `_rateLimiter` is in-memory only, not persisted. Killing and relaunching the app resets all token buckets. `RateLimitException` is also caught by generic `catch(e)` and swallowed.

### 3. User enumeration via distinct error messages
`lib/services/auth_service.dart:545–549`

`user-not-found` → 'No user found' vs `wrong-password` → 'Wrong password'. Different messages reveal whether an email has an account.

### 4. Password reset not rate-limited server-side
`lib/repositories/firebase/firebase_auth_repository.dart:179–187`

Client-side limiter (3 tokens, 1/hour refill) resets on restart. Attacker can spam reset emails to any address.

### 5. Password reset confirms email existence
`lib/services/auth_service.dart:205–217`

`user-not-found` error propagated to UI reveals whether address has account. Should always show 'if that email exists, a reset link was sent'.

## Why It Matters
Finding 1: Account squatting, phishing enabled. Finding 2: Credential stuffing unmitigated. Findings 3+5: Account enumeration.

## Suggested Fix
1. Send verification email after registration; add gate screen checking emailVerified
2. Add explicit `on RateLimitException` handler; persist bucket to SharedPreferences; add server-side rate limiting
3. Merge user-not-found and wrong-password to same message
4. Use Firebase App Check + server-side email limits
5. Always show generic success message on reset

tickets.title: Fix auth MFA & account deletion: MFA removal without re-auth, partial deletion state, audit log race, password minimum (11 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. MFA unenrollment requires only confirmation dialog — no re-authentication
`lib/views/settings/mfa_settings_view.dart:137–177`

Removing MFA factor shows only yes/no dialog. No password re-auth. Attacker with briefly-unlocked device can disable MFA with one tap.

### 2. Account deletion leaves partial state on failure
`lib/services/account/account_deletion_service.dart:152–162`

If `user.delete()` throws after Firestore data already deleted: data gone but auth account lives (GDPR violation). If Firestore fails: auth account stays with orphan data.

### 3. requiresReauth flag silently dropped
`lib/services/account/account_deletion_service.dart:169` sets `result['requiresReauth'] = true` but `ProfileViewModel.deleteAccount()` never checks it.

### 4. Audit log written before auth deletion succeeds
`lib/services/account/account_deletion_service.dart:135–162`

GDPR audit log records 'deletion' before `user.delete()`. If auth delete fails, false audit trail.

### 5. Sessions not invalidated on other devices after password change
`lib/services/auth_service.dart:488–500`

No call to `revokeRefreshTokens`. Attacker sessions remain valid up to 1 hour.

### 6. Password minimum is 6 characters
`lib/viewmodels/auth_viewmodel.dart:306–308` — no complexity check, no breach check.

### 7. MFA phone defaults silently to +46
`lib/views/settings/mfa_settings_view.dart:67–68` — wrong number for non-Swedish users.

### 8. FirebaseAuth.instance used directly in MFA methods
`lib/services/auth_service.dart:246,261,286,343,374,422,431,472` — bypasses DI, untestable.

### 9. GetIt.instance used instead of ServiceLocator
`lib/views/settings/mfa_settings_view.dart:23` + `mfa_challenge_dialog.dart:48`

### 10. Email TLD regex rejects >4 char TLDs
`lib/viewmodels/auth_viewmodel.dart:283–289` — `.museum`, `.photography` blocked.

### 11. Loading spinner stuck on re-auth failure
`lib/widgets/common/profile/handlers/auth_action_handler.dart:57–78` — `Navigator.pop` skipped if `context.mounted` is false.

## Why It Matters
Finding 1: MFA security undermined. Finding 2: GDPR Article 17 compliance gap. Finding 5: Stolen sessions survive password change.

## Suggested Fix
1. Require password re-auth before unenrollMfa
2. Delete auth first; queue Firestore cleanup via Cloud Function
3. Check requiresReauth and show re-auth prompt
4. Move audit log after user.delete() succeeds
5. Call revokeRefreshTokens via Cloud Function on password change
6-11. Raise minimum to 8; force int'l phone format; add MFA to AuthRepository; fix regex; dismiss spinner in finally

tickets.title: Fix shopping & menu: clearCompleted/uncheckAll/export stubs, isLoading stuck, menu quantity corruption, recipe reuse (12 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. clearCompletedItems() and uncheckAllItems() are no-op stubs
`lib/services/unified/modules/shopping_item_management_module.dart:305–306`

Both return `true` but do nothing. Clear-bought and uncheck-all buttons silently succeed without effect.

### 2. addItemsFromRecipe is a stub — always returns true
`lib/services/unified/modules/shopping_item_management_module.dart:307–312`

No items added via this code path.

### 3. isLoading is `final false` — loading spinners never show
`lib/services/unified/unified_shopping_service.dart:146,183`

`final bool _isLoading = false` never mutated. `isSyncing` also missing.

### 4. exportListAsText returns hard-coded mock string
`lib/services/unified/modules/shopping_list_management_module.dart:284`

Users sharing shopping list get 'Mock shopping list export'.

### 5. Menu→shopping conversion corrupts quantities
`lib/widgets/common/input/shopping_list_selector.dart:391–422`

Uses full raw ingredient string (including quantity) as dedup key. '2 dl mjölk' and '3 dl mjölk' are separate items. Exact duplicates get `amount += 1` instead of summing parsed quantities.

### 6. Regenerating menu section can reuse recipes from other sections
`lib/viewmodels/menu/menu_generator.dart:99–118`

`regenerateMenuSection` doesn't exclude recipes already in the menu. Same recipe can appear in Lunch and Middag.

### 7. Empty recipe bucket silently drops menu section
`lib/services/menu_service.dart:93–101`

If no recipes match a requested meal type, section silently omitted. No error shown.

### 8. No dedup when adding menu to existing shopping list
`lib/widgets/common/input/shopping_list_selector.dart:300–351`

Menu items appended without checking if they already exist. Tapping twice doubles all items.

### 9. toggleItemBought rollback uses mutated list + stale listIndex
`lib/services/unified/modules/shopping_item_management_module.dart:276–283`

### 10. firstWhere throws StateError if item not found
`lib/models/unified/unified_shopping_list.dart:521`

### 11. Parse fallback adds '1 st' to every unparseable ingredient
`lib/utils/text/shopping_list_generator.dart:265–274`

### 12. formattedAmount uses English decimal '1.5' not Swedish '1,5'
`lib/models/unified/unified_shopping_item.dart:322–330`

## Why It Matters
Findings 1-4: Core shopping features (clear, uncheck, export) are non-functional stubs. Finding 5: Shopping lists from menus have wrong quantities.

## Suggested Fix
1-2. Implement method bodies using existing addItemsBatchToActiveList pattern
3. Make _isLoading non-final; set true/false around async ops
4. Implement using ShoppingAnalyticsManager.exportListAsText pattern
5. Use IngredientProcessor.parseAndNormalize for quantity extraction and merging
6. Pass currentMenu to exclude already-used recipes
7. Return error listing which meal types couldn't be filled
8. Check existing items by normalized name before appending
9-12. Capture listId not index; add orElse; show name without unit for qty-less items; use toSwedishHalfFraction

tickets.title: Fix onboarding: non-atomic completion, error swallowed, registration bypasses flow, FCM permission fires too early (12 issues)
tickets.description:
## Finding

### 1. completeOnboarding is not atomic — two separate Firestore writes
`lib/viewmodels/onboarding_viewmodel.dart:79–122`

Allergen save and onboarding flag are separate writes. App kill between them = allergen data saved but onboarding re-shown, discarding selections.

### 2. markOnboardingComplete silently swallows exceptions
`lib/services/user_service.dart:502–519`

Catch logs but doesn't rethrow. Caller navigates to home thinking success. Next launch re-shows onboarding.

### 3. Allergen save failure doesn't prevent markOnboardingComplete
`lib/viewmodels/onboarding_viewmodel.dart:83–96`

Return value of `updateAllergenPreferences` not checked. Proceeds to mark complete even if allergens weren't saved.

### 4. Profile null → skips onboarding, shows main app
`lib/main.dart:806–812`

`profile == null` causes code to fall through to `MinaReceptView`. New users see main app flash before onboarding.

### 5. Registration navigates directly to MinaReceptView, bypassing onboarding
`lib/views/auth_view.dart:512–520`

Imperative `pushReplacement` to MinaReceptView on registration success, before AuthWrapper can check onboarding flag.

### 6. FCM permission dialog fires during bootstrap — before onboarding
`lib/services/notifications/fcm_service.dart:94–127`

Permission requested during DI bootstrap. On iOS this is the one-time system dialog — fires without context or explanation.

### 7. Import buttons navigate away without completing onboarding
`lib/views/onboarding/onboarding_import_page.dart:41–53`

User can import a recipe and close the app without 'Slutför' being called. Onboarding not marked complete.

### 8. Deep link processed during onboarding
`lib/main.dart:720–726`

No check for `hasCompletedOnboarding` before processing deep link. Navigation pushed on top of onboarding.

### 9. registerWithEmail doesn't create Firestore profile
`lib/services/auth_service.dart:51–96`

Profile creation is async side-effect of auth stream. Window between auth creation and profile exists.

### 10. New profile doesn't set hasCompletedOnboarding explicitly
`lib/services/user_service.dart:120–134` — relies on model default.

### 11. PageView allows unrestricted swiping past boundaries
`lib/views/onboarding/onboarding_view.dart:62–70`

### 12. Skip button visible on last page — confusing UX
`lib/views/onboarding/onboarding_view.dart:81–106`

## Why It Matters
Findings 1-5: Onboarding flow has multiple bypass paths — new users can reach main app without completing setup. Finding 6: iOS notification permission wasted.

## Suggested Fix
1. Merge allergen save + onboarding flag into single Firestore update
2. Rethrow or return bool from markOnboardingComplete
3. Check return value before proceeding
4. Show loading spinner when profile is null
5. Remove imperative navigation; trust AuthWrapper
6. Defer FCM permission to post-onboarding
7. Mark onboarding complete before navigating to import
8. Check hasCompletedOnboarding before processing deep links
9. Create profile atomically in registration flow
10-12. Set explicitly; use NeverScrollableScrollPhysics; hide Skip on last page
